sessions.phase_label: Test article editorial revision and acceptance
Client feedback and compression-springs landing-page assignment

requirements.title: Test Article Editorial Revision
requirements.definition: Revise the test blog article using the in-document feedback, with more storytelling and engaging introductions that break up long informational lists.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the requested editorial revision of one article; the word-count policy is separate because it can change and be evaluated independently.

requirements.title: Test Article Word-Count Guideline
requirements.definition: Treat the test article's 1800-word target as a flexible guideline rather than a hard maximum, allowing additional content needed for the requested revisions.
requirements.boundary_note: The permissible article length is an independent acceptance constraint rather than merely another storytelling attribute.

requirements.title: Compression Springs Landing-Page Copy Update
requirements.definition: Update the copy on the existing compression-springs landing page according to the forthcoming section-by-section instructions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently requested landing-page copy deliverable; estimates, rates, lead time, meeting logistics, and possible future assignment volume are project-management facts and are excluded.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client mentions later feedback and suggested edits to the test article, but the visible message does not clearly require implementation of those edits and their substantive content is only available through an external document.
